sources.title: Grounded Language-Image Pre-training / GLIP (Li et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Detection reformulated as phrase grounding with unified detection+grounding pre-training (27M grounding data: 3M human + 24M web pairs; self-training-generated grounding boxes): zero-shot COCO 49.8 / LVIS 26.9 AP (no COCO images seen, beating supervised baselines); fine-tuned COCO 60.8 val / 61.5 test-dev; 1-shot GLIP rivals fully-supervised Dynamic Head on 13 transfer tasks; code released.
